title: Counting portions at a community kitchen

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: The board says thirty plates served. How much vegetable bake is left? Some diners asked us to split one serving between two plates.
turns.zh: 看板寫已出餐三十盤。蔬菜烤盤料理還剩多少呢？有些用餐的人要把一份分成兩盤。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Count portions, not plates. A full scoop is one portion. Those split servings were still one scoop each.
turns.zh: 要算份數，不是盤數。一滿勺算一份。那些分盤的每組仍是一勺。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: The side table has a rack marked twelve. Can we count that? Six late diners are waiting, and there are only four scoops here.
turns.zh: 旁桌有一個標著十二的架子，那個能算進去嗎？有六個晚到的人在等，這裡卻只剩四勺。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: That rack has twelve empty plates, not food. Use the bake from the small pan on the warming shelf to make up the difference.
turns.zh: 那個架子上有十二個空盤，沒有食物。用保溫層架上小烤盤裡的料理補足份數。
